# Hoteles Salinas

> Three family-run hotels in Salinas, Santa Elena, Ecuador, one block from the Malecón and Playa de San Lorenzo: Hotel Salinas, Hotel Salinas Costa Azul and Suite Salinas. Run by the Sotomayor family for more than 50 years. Website in Spanish: https://hotelessalinas.com/

## Key facts
- Address: Gral. Enríquez Gallo y Calle 27, Salinas, Santa Elena, Ecuador. All three hotels are on the same corner, one block from the beach.
- Reservations: WhatsApp +593 99 575 5979, email reservas@hotelessalinas.com
- Check-in from 13:00, check-out until 12:00.
- Pool: guests of all three hotels use the pool at Costa Azul. Parking for guests, subject to availability.
- Elevators at Hotel Salinas and Suite Salinas. No ground-floor or accessible rooms at this time.
- Rooms: matrimonial (double) from $50 per night; family rooms (triple to sextuple) from $20 per person; groups from $15 per person. Prices vary by season and holidays.
- Payment: bank transfer or cash. Cancellation: the stay is moved to another date; no refunds.
- Nearby: Playa de San Lorenzo (one block), boat and banana rides from the same beach, humpback whale tours June to September, La Chocolatera (a few minutes by car), Ruta del Spondylus (day trip).
